question: An article whose marked price is ₹800 is sold at a profit of 50% when there are successive discounts of 20%, 10%, and 5% offered by the shopkeeper. The selling price (rounded to the nearest rupee) when the article is sold at a profit of 60%, with the same cost price, is:

Profit = 50%
